narrative: Iran-Oman talks on reopening the Strait of Hormuz corridor pressure the dollar and crude prices, as Tehran weighs allowing European mine clearing to secure safe passage. The dollar retreats as equities firm +1.47% and gold rises +1.29% near $4,143; DXY consolidates +0.01% while VIX holds at 16.3. USD/JPY at 157.45 remains anchored by a 275bp Fed-BoJ carry, though strong options hedging (25d RR -2.76) signals downside risk. Watch the next RBA meeting for the next G10 policy catalyst.
